purpose: A product-code-disjoint, provisional visual check set for missing-field, incomplete-capture and quantity-role errors. Available local images do not supply readable positive MRP, net-quantity or packed-date labels; this is not a positive-recognition accuracy benchmark.

annotation.method: Inspected the exact local photographs with view_image before running any new OCR on this check set. Used indexes only to route photographs and retain attribution. Did not consult Google Vision annotations, new model OCR transcripts, catalogue quantities or arithmetic-derived quantities when labelling.
annotation.priorExposureDisclosure: These six product codes are absent from critical-fields.v1.json, but that does not make them an independent holdout. Health Factory, Maggi, NutriChoice and Maska Chaska are already in the older real-label development collection. The annotating agent previously inspected and ran OCR on another Maska Chaska photo (20.jpg). Some chosen photographs were used by earlier token-level development benchmarks, though those OCR outputs were not consulted for these labels. Amul Taaza shares a brand with an excluded product code. Pretrained model training exposure is unknown.
annotation.selection: Availability sampling: the local collection contains 12 original-size photographs across four non-excluded product codes and 41 candidate thumbnails across six non-excluded codes. Inspected available views seeking critical declarations, then selected one photo per code illustrating the actual coverage/readability limitation. No success-based or model-output-based selection was used. Three selections are original-size photos and three are 400px candidate thumbnails. The set is not random, representative or brand-disjoint.
annotation.freezeRule: Do not silently relabel to fit OCR. Any later label correction must record a human reviewer, reason, previous value and new dataset version. A newly acquired photograph must receive a new sample identity and hash.

source.name: Existing local Open Food Facts India real-label and candidate collections
source.imageIdentity: sha256 of the exact local image bytes; no image transforms or OCR were used for the freeze
source.imageLicense: CC BY-SA, as recorded in the existing source manifests
source.databaseLicense: ODbL 1.0, as recorded in the existing source manifests
source.attribution: Retain each source URL, product URL and the original collection attribution records when redistributing photographs. These labels neither change the image licences nor establish capture dates or contributor identity. No new image was downloaded for this version.

statuses.readable: The full value and requested field identity are visually supported in this exact photograph; provisional positive exact-match label.
statuses.not_visible: No readable value for the requested declaration appears in this photograph. This is not a claim that the complete package lacks a declaration.
statuses.illegible: A relevant declaration or partial heading is visible, but its complete value is not readable in this exact image.
statuses.ambiguous_field: A quantity-like number is readable but its identity or scope as this package's net declaration cannot be established from this photograph.

scoringPolicy.denominator: Only status=readable and metricEligible=true fields enter positive exact-match denominators. Every denominator in this version is zero: report not measurable, never 0% or 100% accuracy. Report predictions on excluded fields separately as unsupported candidates requiring visual review, not automatically false declarations.
scoringPolicy.expectedValues: Readable labels only. All maps are intentionally empty. Missing keys are unlabelled and cannot establish compliant or non-compliant absence.
scoringPolicy.normalization: Preserve digits and date separators. Normalize quantity unit spelling/case only. Do not infer quantity from servings, nutritional per-100g values, promotional counts, catalogue data, adjacent pictured products or unit-price arithmetic.
scoringPolicy.surfaces: surface records only a readable excerpt or a stated partial heading, not a full transcript or exact typography. Null means no accepted excerpt.
scoringPolicy.dateMeaning: Only an explicitly identified packed/manufactured date can receive a readable packDate label. Best-before instructions without a date are not packing dates.
scoringPolicy.falseClearRateReason: No human/officer-adjudicated legal verdicts or complete-package capture labels are provided.
scoringPolicy.claimsAllowed: Provisional abstention and field-role diagnostic checks only. Positive recognition performance, legal correctness and unseen-product accuracy are not measured.
